name: City of Yonkers
gaps: No total/impervious coverage limit in Table 43-3 (building coverage only)
Table 43-3 sets lot width, not frontage or depth
PDR (planned urban redevelopment) has no fixed setbacks/height/coverage; set per comprehensive development plan (§ 43-72C)
FAR band 'base' values computed as base FAR x minimum lot area from Table 43-3 and note 5
Downtown (D-MX, UR-*), L-MX and other mixed-use districts not covered (not county residential codes)
No local wetlands chapter found in the City Code; only NYS DEC rules apply

wetlands.summary: No local wetlands law found in the Yonkers City Code; NYS DEC freshwater wetlands rules (100 ft adjacent area) apply to state wetlands.

steep_slopes.summary: § 43-105B: added site plan review standards when a site has > 5,000 sf of slopes over 15% (regraded slopes max 50%). One- and two-family houses are exempt from site plan review, but clear-cutting or excavation permits require an approved site plan (§ 43-94A).

trees.summary: Ch. 80 Shade Trees: permit from the City to cut, trim or plant trees in public places/streets. No private-lot tree permit; clear-cutting of vegetation/trees needs an approved site plan (§ 43-94A(2)).

stormwater.summary: Ch. 43 Art. XVII and Ch. 56 Art. XVI: SWPPP required for land development activity disturbing 1 acre or more (or part of a larger common plan).

adu.summary: No new accessory apartments; § 43-22 only lets pre-existing accessory apartments continue, inside a single-family house in single-family districts, owner-occupied, occupied by listed relatives.

general.accessory_structures: § 43-40D: not in front yard; at least 3 ft from side and 5 ft from rear lot lines; 1 story / 15 ft max; max 60% of rear yard or each side yard, 75% of rear+side yards combined. Unroofed decks/patios under 3 ft high may project into side/rear yards (§ 43-33P, § 43-41A).
general.pools: § 43-41P: rear or side yard only, not in the minimum required side yard; 6 ft solid screen along adjoining lot lines; 6-10 ft enclosure fence.
general.notes: Corner lots: owner may choose which street yard is the front; the other is a side-front yard (§ 43-33I). Through lots need front yards on both streets and no rear yard (§ 43-33J). Single-family homes on pre-1968 undersized lots allowed if yards are met (§ 43-33F).

S-200.name: S-200 District: detached single-family dwellings on 200-foot lots

max_floor_area.note: Single/two-family: base FAR 0.56 on lot area up to 20,000 sf; FAR 0.38 on the portion of the lot exceeding it (Table 43-3 note 5). Band base = 0.56 x 20,000 sf

accessory.notes: § 43-40D: accessory structures not allowed in front yard; min 3 ft from side and 5 ft from rear lot line; max 1 story or 15 ft; together may cover at most 60% of rear yard or of each side yard (75% of rear+side yards combined)

S-200.source: § 43-27; Table 43-3 Schedule of Dimensional Regulations for Residential Uses (43 Attachment 3), single- and two-family dwelling rows
S-200.notes: Existing lots narrower than 50 ft / shallower than 100 ft may reduce side and rear yards (§ 43-33K-L). Front yard may need to match the average of the two nearest buildings, up to +15 ft (§ 43-33J(2)).

PDR.name: Planned urban redevelopment (PUR), special use permit (§ 43-72C)
PDR.notes: PURs are allowed in designated urban renewal areas on tracts of 2+ acres; they need not meet district dimensional rules and are set by a comprehensive development plan approved by the Planning Board and City Council. Not a district listed in § 43-11.
